# Free Mental Health

> > A comprehensive directory of free and low-cost mental health services across the United States, organized by state and city.

This site helps users find accessible mental health care including community health centers, behavioral health services, and substance abuse treatment facilities that accept Medicaid or offer sliding-scale fees. Coverage spans all 50 states with detailed provider information at the city level.

## Key Topics

- Free mental health services
- Community health centers
- Behavioral health
- Sliding scale fees
- Substance abuse treatment
- Medicaid accepted
- Government-funded mental health
- State mental health resources
- Community mental health centers
- NAMI resources
- Mental health clinics by state
- Low-cost counseling
- Crisis mental health services

## Getting Started

- [Free Mental Health Services](https://www.freementalhealth.us/): Homepage listing free mental health services across US states
- [State Directory](https://www.freementalhealth.us/state/): State directory page for mental health services including NAMI resources

## Major Cities

- [Dallas, TX Free Mental Health Services](https://www.freementalhealth.us/city/tx-dallas): 17 free mental health centers in Dallas, TX including Texas Health
- [Fargo, ND Free Mental Health Services](https://www.freementalhealth.us/city/nd-fargo): 13 free mental health centers in Fargo, ND including Sanford Medical
- [Bismarck, ND Free Mental Health Services](https://www.freementalhealth.us/city/nd-bismarck): 6 free mental health centers in Bismarck, ND including West Central HSC
- [Grand Forks, ND Free Mental Health Services](https://www.freementalhealth.us/city/nd-grand_forks): 5 free mental health centers in Grand Forks, ND including UND services

## North Dakota Services

- [Belcourt, ND Free Mental Health Services](https://www.freementalhealth.us/city/nd-belcourt): Quentin N Burdick Mem Healthcare in Belcourt, Rolette County, ND
- [Beulah, ND Free Mental Health Services](https://www.freementalhealth.us/city/nd-beulah): Coal Country Community Health in Beulah, Mercer County, ND
- [Bowbells, ND Free Mental Health Services](https://www.freementalhealth.us/city/nd-bowbells): Bowbells Health Center in Burke County, ND
- [Center, ND Free Mental Health Services](https://www.freementalhealth.us/city/nd-center): Coal Country Community Health Center in Center, Oliver County, ND
- [Devils Lake, ND Free Mental Health Services](https://www.freementalhealth.us/city/nd-devils_lake): Lake Region Human Service Center in Devils Lake, Ramsey County, ND
- [Grafton, ND Free Mental Health Services](https://www.freementalhealth.us/city/nd-grafton): Northeast Human Service Center in Grafton, Walsh County, ND
- [Mcclusky, ND Free Mental Health Services](https://www.freementalhealth.us/city/nd-mcclusky): Northland Community Health Center in Mcclusky, Sheridan County, ND

## Kentucky Services

- [Frenchburg, KY Free Mental Health Services](https://www.freementalhealth.us/city/ky-frenchburg): 1 free mental health center in Frenchburg, KY including Pathways Inc
- [Inez, KY Free Mental Health Services](https://www.freementalhealth.us/city/ky-inez): Mountain Comprehensive Care Center in Inez, Martin County, KY
- [La Grange, KY Free Mental Health Services](https://www.freementalhealth.us/city/ky-la_grange): Seven Counties Services in La Grange, Oldham County, KY

## Montana Services

- [Columbus, MT Free Mental Health Services](https://www.freementalhealth.us/city/mt-columbus): Columbus Mental Health Center in Stillwater County, MT
- [Glendive, MT Free Mental Health Services](https://www.freementalhealth.us/city/mt-glendive): Eastern Montana CMHC in Glendive, Dawson County, MT

## Individual Providers

- [Community Care Behavioral Health Freehold, NJ](https://www.freementalhealth.us/services/freehold_community-care-behavioral-health): Community Care Behavioral Health in Freehold, NJ with Medicaid accepted
